fields.value: Carpenter Invar 36, annealed bars and strip, yield 276 MPa, ultimate 448 MPa, density 8.05 g/cm3, linear CTE 1.3 µm/m-C near 93 C.
fields.issue: The alloy exists today and is the expansion match. At 562.2 kN the sleeve is 0.410 kg per end and 858.6 kg, 3.81 times the allowance. Frozen least SF is 1.054, global. Re-optimised least SF is 1.245 at k 0.2 and 1.616 at k 0.4.
fields.consequence: Invar now closes. It remains several times the 5 percent allowance. The CTE advantage is not scored as a stress.
fields.next: None, unless a higher allowable or a shorter bonded detail is sourced.
